title: Thanks and goodbyes
summary: Closing thanks and a request for a copy.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: All right. I can’t think of a better ending. It’s been a real pleasure.
And you know what? I hope I get to play with you someday. Maybe I can keep up I’m not sure. All right. Well thanks a lot, Danny.

You’re more than welcome and I’d like to get a copy of this sometime. I’m sure that it will be edited. There’s some things in there that probably would not particularly get your faculty excited, but you know what to do.
